findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_casinos" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List every casino WagerX holds forensic audit data on (40+ operators), with trust score and audit status. Use to discover coverage before calling check_casino, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "top_casinos" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
